objective.statement: Write and recognise the scale of A major.
successCriteria: I know the major scale pattern is tone, tone, semitone, tone, tone, tone, semitone.
I know A major has three sharps: F♯, C♯ and G♯.
I can write the scale of A major.

explanation.text: Every major scale has the same pattern of steps, whatever note it starts on: tone, tone, semitone, tone, tone, tone, semitone.
To start the pattern on A, some notes need sharps to keep the steps right. A major needs three of them.

music.textAlternative: The scale of A major going up: A, B, C sharp, D, E, F sharp, G sharp, A.

explanation.caption: A major: A B C♯ D E F♯ G♯ A. The sharps are F♯, C♯ and G♯.

explanation.text: Check the pattern: A to B is a tone, B to C♯ is a tone, C♯ to D is a semitone, then tone, tone, tone, and G♯ to A is a semitone.
Each letter name is used once, in order. That is why it is C♯ and not D♭: the third note must be some kind of C.
A major: three sharps, F♯ C♯ G♯. The two semitones fall between notes 3 and 4, and 7 and 8.

music.textAlternative: The scale of A major going up with its three sharps.

steps: Play A and B: a tone. Then B to C♯: another tone.
C♯ to D is the first semitone. Then D, E and F♯ are tone steps.
G♯ to A is the second semitone: the scale is finished.

hints: Major: tone, tone, semitone, tone, tone, tone, semitone. Harmonic minor: raise the 7th.

feedback.correct: Right note: the pattern and the letter names fit.

mistakes.semitone-misplaced: Check the pattern of tones and semitones — the semitones aren't where they belong.
mistakes.letter-skipped-or-repeated: Each letter name appears once. You've used one letter twice and skipped another — respell that note.
mistakes.wrong-minor-form: Check which form of the minor scale is asked for, and which notes that form changes.
mistakes.melodic-descent-not-restored: Coming down, the melodic minor uses the notes of the key signature — undo the raised 6th and 7th.
mistakes.key-signature-misapplied: With a key signature, notes it covers don't need accidentals. Without one, every sharp or flat must be written.
mistakes.wrong-direction-or-octave: Check whether the question asks for ascending or descending, and which octave to start on.

feedback.fallback: Not quite. Write one note per letter name first, then check the tones and semitones.
